Which of the diagrams shown above represent subspaces of ${R}^{2}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's analyze each diagram in turn.

- Diagram I does not represent a subspace. The vector $a=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ lies inside the given subset. But 

$$
(-1)\cdot a=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]
$$

lies outside the subset.

- Diagram II does not represent a subspace. The vector $a=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$  lies inside the given subset. But

$$
(-1)\cdot a=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]
$$

lies outside the subset.

- Diagram III represents a subspace. It represents the whole plane, which is considered a special subspace of ${R}^{2}.$

So, the correct answer is "III only".
